why: Guess captures faking a laugh/cheerfulness, matching the narration.
Being framed as fraudsters with legal overtones matches the narration.
Walking into a trap set by the smirking man matches the narration; her anger fits her narrowed eyes.
The diagram chain conveys the owes-him, keeps-her-close, won't-admit logic.
The shield and 'safety net' text suggest he protects her, while the narration says the net being intact means no real closeness yet.
Envying her freedom is close to falling for her freedom, but the 'envies' wording and house icon miss the love and add 'content at home'.
Financial background is right but the narration's point is his rejection of that path via her lack of that presumption, which is missed.
Anxious but still on familiar ground roughly matches, though the safety-net risk idea is absent.
Man hanging from the trellis outside her window while she watches matches.
The dip embrace with hair brushing the floor matches.
Total immersion and sincere surrender read as being fully absorbed in the relationship.
The cliff ledge shows him at an edge feeling no danger, missing the point that a relationship without risk of falling is dead.
